pages.title: Grim Spell
pages.creator: quangvn
pages.description: Grim Spell is a survival game where a lone wizard automatically casts at nearby monsters. Steer away from the horde and collect experience gems to level up. Each level offers three upgrades to choose from, so you can strengthen your spells or improve stats such as movement speed and pickup range. Earn gold for permanent upgrades or tackle bosses in Boss Attack mode.

pages.title: Pixel Path 2
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Pixel Path 2 follows Pixel Tadpole through twenty increasingly difficult platform levels. Jump over pits and spikes, and watch for coconuts falling into your path. Read the terrain ahead before committing to a jump. Getting past one hazard can leave you close to the next, so pay attention to where you land.

pages.title: Skibidi Titans Hide And Seek
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Skibidi Titans Hide And Seek lets you play as a hider or a hunter. As a hider, look for places where you can stay out of sight and move when there is an opening. As a hunter, try to track down the players who evade you. Your character's abilities give you different ways to handle the chase.

pages.title: Kick Lucky Boxes Online
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: In Kick Lucky Boxes Online, launch lucky blocks to find collectible Brainrots and other rewards. Upgrade your kick to send boxes farther and improve your speed so you can return before a tsunami floods the arena. Collect Brainrots across fourteen rarity classes, build up your character through rebirths, or share the game with a second player locally.

pages.title: Bubble classic
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Bubble classic is a score-based bubble shooter. Aim each ball toward a group you can clear and try to keep space open for later shots. The more bubbles you remove, the higher your score climbs. Keep the board under control as long as you can, then compare your result on the world rankings.

pages.title: Brainrot World Hole.io
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Brainrot World Hole.io puts you in control of a hole that grows as it swallows objects. Start with small items and move through the map looking for things that fit. As the opening gets wider, return to larger objects you had to pass up earlier. Keep feeding the hole so it can take in more of the world.

pages.title: Bouncy Bomb Buddies
pages.creator: Hopeful Eye
pages.description: Bouncy Bomb Buddies is a one-on-one platform battle set in candy-colored arenas. Bounce between platforms to grab falling bombs, then throw them at your rival. The arc of a throw matters, so adjust for where the other player is moving. Survive each exchange and take three rounds to win a best-of-five match.

pages.title: ARROW OUT AND LINKER
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: ARROW OUT AND LINKER is a maze puzzle about finding a way out for the arrows. Click an arrow to move it and check where its route leads before choosing the next move. Work through the paths in an order that keeps the exits reachable. Clear the maze by guiding the arrows out.

pages.title: 1945 Air Force Space Shooter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: 1945 Air Force Space Shooter sends a fighter into an ongoing assault by enemy aircraft. Keep firing while you steer through the gaps between incoming bullets. Watch the space around your plane as well as the enemies ahead, especially when several shots cross your path. Clear each wave and stay in the air for the next.

pages.title: Paint Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Paint Rush asks you to cover the white sections of a house with color. Swipe up, down, left or right to move the paint across each surface. Check corners and narrow strips as you work so you can see which sections still need a pass. Cover every remaining white spot to finish the level.

pages.title: Obby Blox Hook
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Obby Blox Hook is a platformer where a grappling hook gets you across gaps. Attach the hook, swing around hazards and let go when the arc will carry you toward the next safe spot. Watch your momentum as you cross each section. Reach the finish by stringing together swings and jumps.

pages.title: Tile Sort - Match 3
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Tile Sort - Match 3 combines sorting with tile matching. Move tiles to make groups of at least three identical pieces and clear them. Think about where a tile will leave room for the next match before moving it. Keep sorting the pieces that remain until you have cleared the board.

pages.title: Murder Mystery
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Murder Mystery is a social deduction game with a murderer, a sheriff and innocent players. The murderer tries to eliminate the others without being identified, while the sheriff tries to identify and shoot the right player. If the sheriff falls, another player can pick up the weapon and take over.

pages.title: Tiles of the Unexpected 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Tiles of the Unexpected 2 is a matching puzzle where the board collapses as you remove groups. Look at which tiles will fall together after a clear and use that to set off chain reactions. The military-themed sequel adds a Time Attack mode, where fast clears help hold off enemy forces for as long as possible.

pages.title: Robbie: Become a Beast
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: Robbie: Become a Beast is a training and racing game where you transform into an animal. Build endurance and speed before challenging other runners. Collect pets to help with training and improve your skills as you win races. The goal is to turn those improvements into stronger performances against your rivals.

pages.title: Cop Simulator
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Cop Simulator lets you explore a city as a police officer on foot or in a vehicle. Move with WASD, look around with the mouse and press F to interact with cars. Take on missions or drive through the city traffic. You can also jump and crouch when moving around on foot.

pages.title: Super Cloner 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Super Cloner 3D is an infiltration game built around the ability to clone yourself. Use that power to get past traps and take out the enemies standing between you and the mission objective. Read the area ahead to decide when cloning will help, then move through each location to finish the secret assignment.

pages.title: Flip It 3D
pages.creator: Kesp Studio
pages.description: Flip It 3D is a platform puzzle where every platform needs to face the same way. Drag knights and goblins onto empty platforms to make room for each flip. Occupied platforms cannot be turned, and goblins can survive only a limited number of flips. Plan where to put each character before turning another platform.

pages.title: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2 is a timed puzzle about connecting matching butterfly wings. Find pairs you can link and clear them before the clock runs down. Clearing a pair can open routes to wings that were harder to reach. Collect coins to change the backgrounds and unlock new wing designs in the shop.

pages.title: Sigil Seeker
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Sigil Seeker gives you a row for collecting mystical symbols from a board of tiles. Tap tiles to add them to the row and collect a sigil by matching three identical ones. Keep an eye on the space you have left. The round ends if the row fills up or the timer reaches zero.

pages.title: Bonnie Fitness Frenzy
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Bonnie Fitness Frenzy combines a gym routine with a makeover. Help Bonnie complete a series of exercises, then switch to applying makeup and choosing sportswear. Try different pieces to put together an outfit that fits her fitness look. The game takes her from the workout to the finished style.

pages.title: Idle Merge Car And Race
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Idle Merge Car And Race lets you run a small racing business. Send cars onto the track to earn money whenever they cross the finish line. Buy cars or open gift boxes, then merge two cars of the same level to build a better model. Reinvest the earnings in shop upgrades and faster income.

pages.title: Snake of Bullets Collect and Shoot!
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Snake of Bullets Collect and Shoot! is a runner where your trail is made of ammunition. Steer to pick up more bullets and build a longer snake. Use the ammunition to shoot through what stands in your way. Line up the pickups you can reach so you have more firepower for the obstacles ahead.

pages.title: Grandma Recipe Apple Pie
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Grandma Recipe Apple Pie follows Annie as she makes her grandmother's pie. Find the ingredients and tools, work through the recipe and choose toppings for the finished dessert. When the pie is ready, pick an outfit for Annie and take a picture. Add emojis to finish the photo from her baking session.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Vegetables
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Vegetables gives you vegetable bubbles to collect by firing matching shots. Aim at groups of the same vegetable and clear enough bubbles to meet the level's target. Watch the lower edge as you choose where to shoot, since the round can end if the bubbles reach the border.

pages.title: Snake Blocks and Numbers
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Snake Blocks and Numbers is an arcade runner where collecting points makes your snake longer. Drag to steer and watch for blocks with high numbers as you pick a route. Gather stars to unlock different snake skins. Keep going for a higher score and see where your run places on the global leaderboard.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Racing Duel
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Dirt Bike Racing Duel takes motocross bikes to courses across seven continents. Get over the terrain and reach the finish without crashing. Ride alone or race a friend in two-player mode. Visit the shop as you progress to upgrade your current bike or pick another one for the next course.

pages.title: Draw Fighter 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Draw Fighter 3D lets you draw the parts of a fighter before sending it into combat. Look at the opponent's equipment and design pieces that can deal with what you see. Try different components when a setup has trouble against an enemy. Win the fight to clear the level and face another design challenge.

pages.title: Tricky Track 3D 2
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Tricky Track 3D 2 is a race where the other runner can interfere from a parallel lane. Aim your shots at red targets to affect the route. A green target tells you the way is open. Watch both lanes as you run so you can react when your opponent tries to slow you down.

pages.title: Springy Walk
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Springy Walk sends a slinky down a staircase toward the finish. Steer it around spikes and try to land on the gems along the way. Touching the center of a gem earns an extra bonus, so line up the slinky carefully when you have room. Reach the end of the stairs to clear the level.

pages.title: Princess Astronaut
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Princess Astronaut follows Princess Blondie on a search for artifacts and minerals on other planets. Look over the scenes and find the objects she needs for her mission. Pay attention to the details as you work through the discoveries. Completing her search earns Blondie a new spacesuit for the adventure.

pages.title: Penguin Hop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Penguin Hop is an arcade crossing game set on winter roads and rivers. Tap to hop forward and swipe sideways to change lanes. Wait for a gap in traffic before moving, then use lily pads to get across the water. Keep the penguin clear of cars and look ahead for the next safe landing.

pages.title: Crashy Racing
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Crashy Racing puts you on a road with slower cars ahead. Swipe sideways to change lanes and swipe up to accelerate when you have room. Look for an opening before moving across traffic, especially as your speed rises. See how fast you can go while keeping the car clear of collisions.

pages.title: City Construction Simulator Excavator Games
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: City Construction Simulator Excavator Games has ten timed construction and transport missions. Drive construction vehicles to the work area and carry out the task assigned to you. Each job gives you six minutes. Leave yourself enough time to maneuver at the site or deliver the load before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Impostor Color Us
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Impostor Color Us gives you eight character pictures and a palette of 23 colors. Choose a picture, then fill its details with the colors you want. The game gives you a score based on how quickly you finish. When you are happy with the result, save a copy of the picture.

pages.title: Save RED Square
pages.creator: mzworks
pages.description: Save RED Square asks you to remove blocks without dropping the red cube off the platform. Tap the wooden and glass pieces in an order that gives the cube somewhere safe to land. Look at what each block is supporting before you break it. Clear the removable pieces while keeping the cube on the base.

pages.title: Super Pixel
pages.creator: Smart Play Studios
pages.description: Super Pixel is a side-scrolling platform game with three levels. Use the left and right arrows to move and press Up twice for a double jump. Get over obstacles and land on creatures from above to defeat them. Pick up strawberries for a higher score and finish each stage with a life left.

pages.title: Easter 2021 Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Easter 2021 Collection asks you to gather specific Easter items before time runs out. Drag across at least three identical neighbors in a horizontal, vertical or diagonal chain, then release to collect them. Longer chains can give you bonuses, and a chain of more than seven adds time. Meet the item target to finish the level.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions Candy 640 seconds
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions Candy 640 seconds is a timed tile-matching game built around a rotating stack. Turn the stack to find exposed tiles with the same candy symbol and remove them in pairs. Each clear opens up more tiles. Keep checking the other faces of the stack as you work against the clock.

pages.title: Nitro Knights.io
pages.creator: Nikita Osyak
pages.description: Nitro Knights.io brings lance combat to futuristic hovercraft. Point your knight in the direction you want to move, and line up the lance to strike your rival. Keep an eye on where opponents are headed so you can approach from a better angle. Equip another hovercraft as you work through the battles.

pages.title: Apocalypse Truck
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Apocalypse Truck is a driving game set in a world overrun by zombies. Use A and D or the left and right arrows to control the truck. Press W or Up to make it jump. Time your jumps as you move through the route and keep the vehicle going through zombie territory.

pages.title: My Pizza Outlet
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: My Pizza Outlet puts you behind the counter of a pizza shop. Take calls, check what each customer ordered and follow the recipe as you prepare it. Get the finished pizza out on time and see what review the customer gives you. Work through the next order as it comes in.

pages.title: Super Hitmasters Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Hitmasters Online is a spy action puzzle where you use weapons to take out enemies in each layout. Look over the scene before making your move so you can reach every target. Earn coins as you clear stages and use them to unlock weapons, clothing and characters for later missions.

pages.title: Tie Dye Master 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Tie Dye Master 3D is a clothing design game where you create tie-dye patterns on shirts and pants. Choose your colors and apply them to the garment to see how they spread and combine. Try the ice tie-dye technique for a watercolor effect, then start with a new garment to experiment with another palette.

pages.title: PUZZDOT
pages.creator: PORKOFF GAMES
pages.description: PUZZDOT is a sliding puzzle where your piece keeps moving until it hits a point. Swipe or use the arrow keys to send it across the board. Plan the stopping point for each move, especially when a later route depends on it. Clear the points and unlock padlocks to solve the puzzles.

pages.title: Gate Rusher Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Gate Rusher Online sends a rolling ball down a track lined with gates and roadblocks. Slide the ball left or right to line up with each opening. Look beyond the gate you are about to cross so you can prepare for the next one. Keep the ball moving without hitting an obstacle or missing a gate.

pages.title: Kid Maestro
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Kid Maestro is a music game played on a digital piano. Watch for the star and click the key it marks to sound the next note. Follow the cues through the melody, one key at a time. Try the available songs to practice moving between notes as the star changes position.

pages.title: Mine Survival
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Mine Survival is a block-removal puzzle about landing Steve on a safe platform. Pick which blocks to remove and watch how the remaining pieces support him. Clear a path to the correct platform without making him fall past it. Work out where he will drop before taking away the block under him.

pages.title: Fun 90 Degrees
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fun 90 Degrees is a survival arcade game played inside a box. Use a click or tap to change how you move as objects enter the play area. Watch both your current path and the space the next object will cross. Avoid collisions for as long as possible to build a higher score.

pages.title: Best Friends Adventure
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Best Friends Adventure gives you two cube characters to guide at the same time. Use W for one character and the Up arrow for the other, or use the touch controls. Time each jump for the obstacles in that character's path. Pick up coins and keep both travelers moving along the endless road.

pages.title: Trains For Kids Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Trains For Kids Coloring has eight train pictures and 23 colors to work with. Pick a scene and use the palette to color the train and its surroundings. The game scores you on how quickly you complete the picture. You can save the result once you have finished filling it in.

pages.title: Traffic Command
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Traffic Command puts you in charge of lights at busy intersections. Stop cars on one road while traffic on the crossing road moves through. Watch how the queues build before changing a light, and wait for the junction to clear. The goal is to keep cars moving without sending them into each other.

pages.title: Balls Out 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Balls Out 3D is a puzzle where you rotate a maze to bring balls to a tube. Turn the structure and let gravity move the balls along its channels. Watch where they collect when the path changes direction. Keep adjusting the angle until you can guide the remaining balls to the exit.

pages.title: Stickman Ping Pong
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Stickman Ping Pong is a table tennis game where you use the mouse to make returns. Follow the ball after each bounce and move into position for the next shot. Try to put the ball past your opponent while staying ready for a quick return. Play on different courts and build your score one rally at a time.

pages.title: Great Brain Practice
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Great Brain Practice is a series of visual puzzles played with the mouse. Pay attention to the pictures and tiles as they appear, then make your selections for the round. The game tracks your score across the challenges, so you can see how far you get and try to improve your best result.

pages.title: Tap Candy : Sweets Clicker
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tap Candy : Sweets Clicker is a production game where each tap helps make sweets. Keep tapping to build output, then choose and upgrade the tools in your candy factory. Reinvest in equipment that helps the factory turn out more candy. Use those improvements to make a bigger batch on the next round of upgrades.

pages.title: Football Masters
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Football Masters lets you pick a team and enter a football tournament. Play against computer opponents on your own or play with or against a friend. Move your player into position to shoot and guard your goal when the other side has the ball. Win the matches that stand between your team and the title.

pages.title: Christmas Craft Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Christmas Craft Coloring gives you eight holiday pictures to color. Pick an illustration and try different colors on the objects in the scene. You can give each picture its own palette, then use the camera button to download the finished version. Switch pictures whenever you want to start a new one.

pages.title: Lincoln Corsair Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Lincoln Corsair Puzzle is a jigsaw game with six pictures of the Lincoln Corsair. Choose an image and assemble it from 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Look for details on the car and in the background to identify neighboring pieces. Try the same picture at a higher piece count for a harder layout.

pages.title: Starcraft Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Starcraft Coloring is a digital coloring game with eight spaceship designs. Choose an outline and color the cockpit, wings and other parts with the brush. Change the brush size to work on narrow panels or broader sections, and use the eraser to correct a stroke. Use the camera button to save the finished picture.

pages.title: Jewels Match3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Jewels Match3 is a gem puzzle where groups of three or more matching jewels clear from the board. Use the mouse to set up a match and watch how the remaining jewels fill the empty spaces. Look for places where one clear could leave another match ready to make.

pages.title: dunk hoop
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: In dunk hoop, you move the basket instead of shooting the basketball. Guide the hoop beneath the falling balls and line up the opening to catch them. Watch for the next ball as soon as one passes through so you can shift the basket into place and keep making catches.

pages.title: Hearts Connect
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hearts Connect asks you to collect a minimum number of hearts before running out of moves. Match at least three hearts of the same color and check which colors the level still needs. A tutorial introduces the basic matches, and later stages teach more matching abilities as the boards get harder.

pages.title: Horror Granny
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Horror Granny is an escape game where you move through rooms and wards while trying to avoid Granny. Explore the building and look for doors that take you closer to an exit. Use WASD to move, Left Shift to run and Space to jump. Keep track of where Granny is as you search for a way out.

pages.title: Kendall Vs Kylie Yeezy Edition
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Kendall Vs Kylie Yeezy Edition is a dress-up game built around two Yeezy wardrobes. Style Kendall and Kylie separately with clothing and accessories from the collection. Try different pairings and see how the same style changes from one sister to the other. Put together a distinct outfit for each of them.

pages.title: Flick Basketball
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Flick Basketball is a timed arcade shooting game. Flick the ball toward the basket with the mouse and adjust your next shot based on where it lands. A clean basket earns three points. Make enough shots to extend your time and keep playing, then see how high you can take your score.

pages.title: Flying Easter Bunny
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Flying Easter Bunny asks you to keep a bunny in the air while collecting Easter eggs. Guide the bunny toward the eggs as they come into reach and try to gather as many as you can. Each egg helps build your score, so watch where the next one is before changing course.

pages.title: New Platform
pages.creator: stoneye
pages.description: New Platform is a side-scrolling arcade platformer with coins, blocks and power-ups. Jump between ledges and look for coins as you explore each stage. Watch what is below you before dropping to a lower section. Use the platforms to reach more of the course and collect what you can along the way.

pages.title: EG Karting
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Karting is a timing game about keeping a car on a road. Click or tap when the car needs to turn and watch which direction it is facing, since it can reverse. The pace increases as you go. Make each turn in time to keep the run going and add to your score.

pages.title: Commando Attack
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Commando Attack is a shooter with twenty levels and a choice of first-person or third-person view. Move through each stage, aim with the right mouse button and fire with the left. Use crouching and running to get into position. Press G to throw a grenade and C to switch the camera view.

pages.title: The Black and White
pages.creator: Fast Games
pages.description: The Black and White follows two characters stranded on a planet of portals. Guide them to the portals that can take them home. Use the arrow keys to move and jump, and press Space to switch characters. Work out how to get each traveler across the level as you look for a way back.

pages.title: Mohex
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Mohex is a puzzle where colored hexagons need to reach matching positions. Use the color of each piece to identify its destination and decide which one to move first. One move can close off space another hexagon needs. Plan the order so every piece can reach its place without leaving you stuck.

pages.title: Stellar Shooters
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Stellar Shooters is a sci-fi combat game with three playable heroes and three maps. Choose a hero and fight with the available weapons as you move through the setting. Try different weapons as you get to know each map. Look for clear firing positions and watch where opponents can approach from.

pages.title: Chat Stories
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Chat Stories presents short fiction as conversations in a text messenger. Tap to read the next part of an exchange and follow the story as new messages appear. Animated gifts, emojis and other chat details appear alongside the dialogue. The format lets the characters reveal what happened one message at a time.

pages.title: Tornado.io
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Tornado.io puts you in control of a tornado that grows as it destroys objects. Move through the area and hit things the storm can sweep up. As the tornado gets bigger, go after larger targets you passed earlier. Keep building its size as you try to become the most destructive storm on the board.

pages.title: Fireboy and Watergirl 2 Light Temple
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fireboy and Watergirl 2 Light Temple is a platform puzzle about guiding two characters to their exits. Direct light through the temple to help open the way, and send each character along the route that is safe for them. Fireboy must avoid water and Watergirl must avoid fire. Move the pair with WASD and the arrow keys.

pages.title: Car Toys Season 1
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Car Toys Season 1 is a vehicle puzzle game set in a town disrupted by troublemaking cars. Use the police car, ambulance and fire truck to help restore order across 48 levels. Work out where each vehicle needs to go before you set it in motion. Use the available help if a stage leaves you stuck.

pages.title: Cinderella Shopping World
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Cinderella Shopping World is a dress-up game about putting together a modern outfit for Cinderella. Browse the clothing options and try different pieces with the mouse or by tapping. Look at how the items work together, then change anything that feels out of place before settling on her shopping look.

pages.title: Racing Cars 25 Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Racing Cars 25 Differences puts nearly identical car pictures side by side. Search for details that appear in one image but look different in the other. Compare the outlines and smaller features as you go, and mark each difference you find. Find all 25 differences to finish the game.

pages.title: Risky Trip
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Risky Trip is a driving game where the goal is to travel as far as you can. Speed up when the road opens and slow down to get past obstacles. Collect coins on the route and spend them on a new car. Try another run to see how far the next vehicle takes you.

pages.title: Whack a creep
pages.creator: Erigatohishima
pages.description: Whack a creep is a reaction game set in a spooky mansion. Watch for monsters to pop into view and hit them while they are visible. Keep scanning the play area as soon as you land a hit so you can catch the next one. Try to whack as many creeps as you can.

pages.title: King of Gems
pages.creator: Erigatohishima
pages.description: King of Gems is a timed gem puzzle about chaining matches into combos. Watch for groups you can clear quickly and look for a follow-up before the first match is gone. Combos raise your score and help extend your time. Keep the chain going to make the most of each round.

pages.title: Kimono Cutie Dress Up
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Kimono Cutie Dress Up lets you style a character in a kimono and choose a hairstyle to go with it. Try the different wardrobe pieces and see how they look together on the model. Once you have finished the outfit, use the game's save option to keep a picture of the result.

pages.title: Alchemist Master
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Alchemist Master is a combination puzzle about discovering what basic elements can make. Start with ingredients such as earth, wind and fire, then try bringing them together in different pairs. Keep track of the results as you experiment. Each discovery gives the young alchemist another part of the world to work with.

pages.title: Annie Cooking Donuts
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Annie Cooking Donuts puts you in Annie's shop to make donuts for her customers. Work through the cooking steps, then pick candy, fruit and other toppings to decorate the batch. Try different combinations on the finished donuts and get them ready for the customers who come to the shop.

pages.title: Dove Hipster Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Dove Hipster Dolly Dress Up H5 uses mystery boxes to build Dove's outfit. Open the boxes and work with the clothing, accessories and colorful hairstyles you find. Choose pieces that go together to create her hipster look. When the outfit is finished, take a picture for Dove's fashion album.
